course.title: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS) | Taylor's University
quotes: Duration 5-year Study options Full Time Only Intake Month April and September Offered by School of Medicine

Effective 1 July 2025, a 6% Service Tax will be imposed on non-Malaysian citizens, applicable to all fees and charges, except International Security Deposit and EMGS application fees. Fees shown in the Fee Schedule are exclusive of the 6% Service Tax.
Note : Housemanship in Malaysia is open to Malaysian citizens only.
A Level Min. BBB / ABC / AAC in Biology, Chemistry and Physics / Mathematics

International Baccalaureate (IB) Min. 33 points including 2 science subjects (Biology and Chemistry) at Higher Level (HL) and Mathematics at HL with a min. score of 5 each in Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics
A pass in SPM/O-level or equivalent with 5Bs each in Biology, Chemistry, Physics and Mathematics / Additional Mathematics and another subject at school level or its equivalent.
INTERNATIONAL STUDENTS IELTS Band 6.0 TOEFL iBT 60

program.name: Medicine (MBBS)
program.summary: Bachelor of Medicine, Bachelor of Surgery (MBBS), 5 years full time, intakes in April and September. Housemanship in Malaysia is open to Malaysian citizens only.

application_requirements.name: Housemanship
application_requirements.description: Housemanship in Malaysia is open to Malaysian citizens only, so international graduates must plan their first doctor jobs elsewhere.

application_requirements.name: Service tax
application_requirements.description: A 6% Service Tax applies to non-Malaysian citizens on top of the fees shown (from 1 July 2025).

costs.note: International: USD 134,937 for the whole 5-year programme (2026), shown as USD 26,987 a year. Excludes the 6% Service Tax for non-Malaysian citizens. Living costs are published by Taylor's in MYR only, so they aren't added to this USD figure.
Malaysian students: MYR 446,690 for the whole 5-year programme (2026), shown as MYR 89,338 a year.

admissions.threshold: Medicine: minimum BBB / ABC / AAC in Biology, Chemistry and Physics / Mathematics.

english.min_score: IELTS Band 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 60 (international students).

admissions.threshold: Medicine: minimum 33 points, with Biology, Chemistry and Mathematics at Higher Level, each at a minimum of 5.
